structured_output.notes: Baseline pass was constrained: the Anarock Q1/Q2 2026 Bengaluru PDFs, the Knight Frank H1 2026 PDF and the NHB release could not be read (compressed PDF, TLS error). Deccan Herald and JLL pages returned 403. Site-filtered searches for The Hindu and Economic Times returned nothing from those outlets. These figures appeared only in search-engine summaries or the weak PropNewz blog, so I did not report them (no verbatim excerpt): Anarock Q2 2026 quoted rates (Whitefield 10,850, Sarjapur Road 11,560, Thanisandra Main Road 10,300, Electronic City 7,450, Mysore Road 8,040 INR/sqft, city average 9,450); Knight Frank H1 2026 Bengaluru (27,968 sales, avg Rs 9,354/sqft, +9%, unsold 74,299, KR Puram +20%, Sarjapur Road +3%); NHB RESIDEX Bengaluru +11.3% YoY in Jul-Sep 2025; Anarock Bagaluru +90% for 2019 to H1 2024. A follow-up should extract those PDFs locally with pdftotext. Sources disagree sharply on price levels: PropTiger puts the city average at Rs 9,785-9,931/sqft, Anarock's average is a different measure (about Rs 9,300-9,450), and Knight Frank's is about Rs 9,354, so none are comparable across agencies. Plot-rate evidence is weak (broker and portal blogs only) and no registry data was found. Rental yield evidence is limited to broker blogs, which gave roughly 3-4.5% gross for Whitefield and Sarjapur Road, and none is reported. PropEquity was said to show a 6% seven-city decline in Q3 2026 against Anarock's +3%, but the original release was not found.
